title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-07-14
content:
Release Engineering Weekly Meeting — 2026-07-14
Time: 10:00–10:45 PT (Zoom)
Attendees: Marcus Rivera (owner), Ava Chen, Priya Nair, Liam Patel, Sofia Martinez, +1 (on-call)
Note taker: Marcus Rivera

Agenda:
- Status of current release train (Q3 alpha -> canary -> prod)
- Hotfix updates (RINF-2378)
- Changelog signoff for 2026-07-15 release
- CI/Release infra: flaky e2e investigation and rollouts
- Rollback/fallback readiness and SLAs

Quick round-robin (standup style):
- Marcus: Alpha scheduled for canary tomorrow (7/15). Coordinating DB migration window (7/16 02:00–03:00 UTC).
- Ava: Hotfix RINF-2378 (model param mismatch) merged to hotfix branch; smoke tests passing in staging. Preparing patch PR to prod (PR #4222).
- Priya: Changelog draft in Confluence updated; reviewers: product & docs. Need final signoff by EOD 7/14.
- Liam: CI flakes — identified 3 flaky e2e tests (search-smoke, embeddings-load-test, rolling-update). Working on retries and test isolation; tentative fix pushed to test-runner image.
- Sofia: Canary telemetry looks stable for latency p99 on hosted API VPCs; watching error budget for streaming endpoints.

Meeting notes / decisions:
1) Release train status
   - Alpha -> Canary planned: canary start 2026-07-15 09:00 PT; target 24-hour canary window.
   - Canary policy: 5% traffic for first 3 hours, 20% next 6 hours if no regressions, then 50% if stable. Manual promotion to prod after 24h and QA signoff.
   - Decision: Keep model-quantization changes out of this train (deferred to next train) due to risk observed in internal perf tests.

2) Hotfix RINF-2378 (model param mismatch causing tokenization error)
   - Root cause: backward-incompatible config param introduced in model packaging pipeline.
   - Status: Patch applied to hotfix branch; staging smoke tests green.
   - Action: PR #4222 to prod approved by eng-leads, scheduled for 2026-07-14 20:00 PT with rolling restart.
   - Rollback plan: If error rate > 0.5% for 15m window, automatic rollback to previous model variant and trigger on-call.

3) Changelog and release notes
   - Priya posted draft: Confluence page "2026 Q3 Release Train" updated. Need product signoff and legal review for one privacy-related line.
   - Action: Priya to get product signoff by 18:00 PT 7/14; Marcus to ping legal for a quick review (linked artifact on Confluence).

4) CI / e2e flakes
   - Liam: three flaky tests causing pipeline delays ~12% of runs. Root cause partly due to shared test-data races and insufficient timeouts.
   - Action: Liam to merge test-runner image fix and update test harness by 7/15. Temporary mitigation: increase concurrent test shards limited to 8 for release windows.

5) Observability & rollback readiness
   - Canary dashboards updated with new canary policy thresholds. Sofia to add streaming-endpoint p95/p99 thresholds to the canary alerting rule by 7/15.
   - Action: Ava to validate canary alert playbook and verify Slack/PagerDuty runbooks are wired for automatic rollback triggers.

6) Change log items of note (for external release notes)
   - Added: Improved caching for prefix/KV cache to reduce token cost for long-context requests (internal perf win but not enabled in this train).
   - Fixed: Tokenization mismatch in custom packaging pipeline (RINF-2378).
   - Improved: Canary routing policy now respects customer tiering for dedicated fleets.

Risks & Blockers:
- DB migration window overlaps with planned infra maintenance on 7/16; Marcus to coordinate with infra team to avoid overlap.
- Legal review for the privacy line in release notes pending; blocks public release notes until cleared.
- e2e flakiness currently slowing some release pipelines — mitigation in progress.

Action items (owner — due):
- Ava Chen — execute hotfix PR #4222 deploy to prod (2026-07-14 20:00 PT) and validate post-deploy smoke checks (due: 2026-07-14 21:00 PT).
- Priya Nair — get product & legal signoff on changelog draft (due: 2026-07-14 18:00 PT).
- Liam Patel — merge test-runner fix and reduce flaky tests via isolation changes (due: 2026-07-15 EOD).
- Sofia Martinez — add streaming p95/p99 thresholds to canary alerts and verify dashboards (due: 2026-07-15 12:00 PT).
- Marcus Rivera — coordinate DB migration window with infra and schedule final canary->prod decision meeting (due: 2026-07-15 10:00 PT).

Follow-ups / next meeting:
- Next release engineering sync: 2026-07-21 10:00 PT.
- Short check-in (canary decision) scheduled for 2026-07-15 11:00 PT — 15m.

Misc notes / links referenced during meeting:
- Jira: RINF-2345 (Q3 release planning), RINF-2378 (hotfix)
- GH PRs: platform#4210 (db-migration-scripts), platform#4222 (hotfix-tokenization)
- Confluence: 2026 Q3 Release Train (changelog + rollout plan)
- Slack thread: #releases (pinned notes + canary updates)

Meeting closed: 10:45 PT.
Recorded by Marcus Rivera.
